title: Lung architecture
creator: Isabel Uwagboe
caption: The intricate cellular architecture of the deep lung, revealed through immunofluorescence microscopy.
alt: Branching orange and gold structures surround dark air spaces in human lung tissue, with blue cell nuclei and scattered bright green cells.
recognition: Winner · KCL Nikon Imaging Centre competition, 2024

title: The geometry of mitosis
creator: Bhagya Lakshmi Ravindranath
caption: A floral arrangement of dividing cells reveals the geometry of mitosis.
alt: A red and green microscopic flower sits between two silvery butterfly-like chromosome arrangements on black.
recognition: Joint winner · 3rd Danish BioImaging Microscopy Image Contest, 2026

title: Ethereal onion skin
creator: Ria Rodriguez
caption: Folded onion epidermis becomes an ethereal landscape in blue and violet fluorescence.
alt: Translucent folds of onion skin glow violet, blue and turquoise against a deep blue background.
recognition: Joint winner · 3rd Danish BioImaging Microscopy Image Contest, 2026

title: Winter’s Anatomy — When Lungs Become Trees
creator: Claudia Victoria Benke
affiliation: Phase Contrast Imaging Flagship Node Trieste
caption: The branching airways of a human lung echo a leafless winter tree.
alt: A finely branching grey lung airway structure casts a tree-like shadow across a pale background.
recognition: Winner · Euro-BioImaging Four Seasons of the Invisible — Winter

title: Nano Ice skaters
creator: Hélène Roberge
caption: Frozen dust particles resemble tiny skaters in a chance microscopic winter scene.
alt: Small grey clusters resemble figures skating over a diagonally ridged, snowy-looking surface.
recognition: Runner-up · Euro-BioImaging Four Seasons of the Invisible — Winter

title: Primula veris — First of spring
creator: Sebastian Wasserstrom
caption: A pollen grain rests on the textured petal of a cowslip, one of spring’s first flowers.
alt: A round green pollen grain rests on a deeply textured golden petal against a blue background.
recognition: Runner-up · Euro-BioImaging Four Seasons of the Invisible — Spring
